description: This script automates the process of merging pull requests into the Apache Spark repository, including handling conflicts, cherry-picking, and updating associated JIRA issues. It manages git operations, interacts with GitHub and JIRA APIs, and provides user prompts for manual intervention.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Prints an error message in red color.

methods.name: bold_input
methods.description: Prompts the user for input with bold formatting.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a given URL, handling authentication and errors.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message, performs cleanup, and exits.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a shell command and returns its output.

methods.name: continue_maybe
methods.description: Prompts user to continue or abort, with optional cherry-pick abort.

methods.name: clean_up
methods.description: Restores git state and deletes temporary branches.

methods.name: merge_pr
methods.description: Merges a pull request into target branch, handling conflicts and commit details.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Cherry-picks a merge commit into another branch.

methods.name: print_jira_issue_summary
methods.description: Prints a formatted summary of a JIRA issue.

methods.name: get_jira_issue
methods.description: Prompts and retrieves a JIRA issue, with validation.

methods.name: resolve_jira_issue
methods.description: Resolves a JIRA issue, updating fix versions and comments.

methods.name: choose_jira_assignee
methods.description: Prompts user to assign a JIRA issue to a user.

methods.name: grant_contributor_role
methods.description: Adds a user to the JIRA contributors role.

methods.name: assign_issue
methods.description: Assigns a JIRA issue to a user.

methods.name: resolve_jira_issues
methods.description: Resolves multiple JIRA issues based on title content.

methods.name: standardize_jira_ref
methods.description: Standardizes JIRA references in PR titles and texts.

methods.name: get_current_ref
methods.description: Returns current git branch or commit SHA.

methods.name: initialize_jira
methods.description: Initializes JIRA client with authentication.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main workflow for merging PRs, handling conflicts, and updating JIRA.
